title: SAM_ZERO_PARAMETER_SN_BAO_DISTANCE_TEST

measurement_inputs_external_not_catalog_.r_d_method: EH fitting formula given (Omega_m, Omega_b, H_0)

P1.name: SN weighted-mean residual
P1.details: Pantheon+SH0ES z>0.01 non-calibrator sample at H_0=73.04 with no offset fit, no host_logmass correction

P2.name: DESI DR1 BAO chi^2
P2.details: Substrate Omegas at H_0=68.76, EH-computed r_d, diagonal errors

P5.name: SN null-distribution percentile
conditions: 1000 random Omega_m in [0.05, 0.95]; Omega_b fixed; H_0 = 73.04

implementation_discipline.trial_seeds: P5 uses seeds 0..999; P6 uses seeds 10000..10999 (different family from P5)

verdict_ladder.PASS: P1-P6 all hold under canonical substrate values
verdict_ladder.BOUNDARY: P1, P2, P3 all hold (direct prediction-vs-data) but at least one of P4, P5, P6 fails
verdict_ladder.FAIL: P1 fails OR P2 fails OR P3 fails

rule_9_falsifier: The claim that SAM's substrate-only spine reproduces Pantheon+SH0ES, DESI DR1 BAO, and Planck 2018 r_d with zero catalog fit, shows the standard SN-vs-BAO H_0 probe-split, and is significantly more extreme than random parameter draws on both probes.
